desc: A short path through Allen Kang's work: a no-code workflow builder, prototypes in code, a design system, and things that already run.
lede: I’m Allen, a product designer in Toronto. Eight years designing, the last five on CRM and workflow tools, including a no-code automation builder built from zero. I prototype in code with Claude and Cursor when a mock can’t answer the question.
caption: Press Run. Every step opens the case behind it.
h1: I designed a no-code automation builder for nonprofits, from first interview to release.
contact: Automation’s research is the part I’d most like to walk you through.
